exceptions.reason: Source-bank replay is evidence-only. Every ambiguity, singularity, sign typo, missing prior context and coefficient typo in validation.json excludes the defective source from replenishment counts; originals remain unchanged.

Native grader accepts canonical and distributed double-angle expressions but reports product-form trig equivalents unresolved. This bounded grading limitation is retained; radio variants can fill the moderate reserve without relying on those entries.

Easy has at most 60 parameter triples; hard at most 60; moderate at most 505 before whole-bank rejection and existing-content exclusion. Replenishment samples at most 1000 candidates per needed level and leaves any unfilled distinct reserve explicit. New evidence reopens classification.
